statement: If D ∼ = D ⊗ Z, then W(D) is almost unperforated. More generally, if W(D) is almost unperforated, u, v ∈ D+, u ∈ IdealD(v), and d([u]) < d([v]) for every dimension function d with d([v]) = 1, then u ≾ v.
